tldr: A finite expected number of noisy phase retests leaves persistent attenuation uncertainty even when every finite-row population law identifies the causal policy value. The research target is the sharp calibration-budget frontier for both all-rule squared error and the shortest uniformly honest connected intervals on the exact circular benchmark. Uniform two-sided comparison of the full data with an independent Gaussian and wrapped-mark Poisson experiment supports converging rational primal and dual certificates and original-data attainment with coverage at least \(90\%\) at every legal finite row. The known-channel comparison, a strict positive-budget cost, budget monotonicity and the iterated oracle limit are part of the kernel; exact critical budgets and least-favourable structure remain answer-open.
gap: Huang and Zhang permit consistently estimated channels, while repeated-measurement deconvolution results rely on increasing paired information. Finite-prior risk and confidence-set computation leave the connected full-continuum certificate and original-data reverse reconstruction to be established for this finite wrapped-pair likelihood.
fill: The named objects are the two optimal value functions, their certified continuum approximations and their exactly honest data-only attaining sequences. They quantify prospective calibration effort for randomized timing-policy studies, without assigning the benchmark model to observational hospital records.
